sites.name: Principal executive offices
sites.description: Principal executive offices of major businesses, 960-1 West Wen Yi Road, Yu Hang District, Hangzhou.

source.label: Alibaba Group Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, Item 4 (Information on the Company)
source.quote: The principal executive offices of major businesses within Alibaba Group are located at 960-1 West Wen Yi Road, Yu Hang District, Hangzhou 311121, People's Republic of China.

notes: Alibaba publishes no state or country economic-impact data. The FY2026 20-F (year ended Mar 31, 2026) gives 131,462 full-time employees at Mar 31, 2026 with no country split, owned facilities of ~18.7 million sq m, and data centers in Chinese Mainland, Hong Kong SAR, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Philippines, Singapore, UAE, Germany, the UK, Japan, South Korea, Mexico and the United States, with no figures per country, so those are not rows. The FY2026 ESG report (HKEX, June 18, 2026; the same report is furnished as Exhibit 99.2 to a June 18, 2026 Form 6-K, but that PDF's text layer is font-encoded and unreadable, so the HKEX copy is cited) gives employee shares by work location (percentages, not headcounts); the percent rows list four values under five year headers (FY2022-FY2026), and the layout aligns them with FY2023-FY2026, so the last value is FY2026; the three shares sum to 100.0. Headcounts by location are not derived. The HQ site is now quoted from the 20-F itself (the FY2026 filing carries no Hong Kong annual report exhibit).
